name: CrisisFlow Logistics Specialist
description: A2A specialist agent for humanitarian supply chain optimization. Queries live inventory across 6 real UNHRD (UN Humanitarian Response Depot) hubs, calculates aid requirements by disaster type and severity, and dispatches optimal convoy combinations with transport mode selection (air/sea/land) and ETA calculation.

skills.name: Allocate Aid From UNHRD Hubs
skills.description: Given a disaster type, severity (1-5), affected population, and event coordinates, selects optimal UNHRD depot(s), commits live inventory, and returns a full convoy manifest with ETAs.
examples: Allocate humanitarian aid for a severity 4 cyclone in Mozambique with 50,000 people affected.
Which UNHRD hubs should respond to a magnitude 6.8 earthquake near Kathmandu?
Dispatch medical kits and field vehicles to coordinates 13.5, 45.2 for a flood emergency.
